english.title: Attempt to procure a poison / noxious thing to cause a miscarriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to unlawfully procure a poison or other noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..), knowing that the same was intended to be unlawfully used or employed with intent to procure the miscarriage of a woman named **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 59 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempt to unlawfully procured
poison / noxious thing
knowing it was intended
for unlawful use / employment
with intent to procure miscarriage of woman

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See H2402 for the offence of procure a poison/noxious thing to cause a miscarriage.
(ii) A woman having an abortion does not commit an offence when acting in relation to her own pregnancy, see section 241 of the Crime and Policing Act 2026.
(iii) The woman in this case does not have to be with child (pregnant).
